text: I support AJG and hold my objection. An H1 reclaim of ma_20 beats a resting buy in the zone, but is not my entry. AJG is a position case: a new high, ABOVE_STRUCTURE, and the entry is a buy stop over bar_high (C27). A pullback to the 20-day makes it a swing case: that needs a daily set-up bar with all five conditions, entry a buy stop over its high (C3, C5). My canon does not trade hourly closes. What would change my mind: a daily bar showing cci_20 under -100, bar_low at or under ma_20, and close over ma_40. Then I ratify WATCH with the trigger trade_above:bar_high on D.
